description: Which span attributes carry text a person, a tool or a model wrote (#241). A name covers the key itself and every key below it, after a dot. A key under a text name is text; else a key under a plain name carries no text; any other key is text. A key holding a never name as whole segments anywhere, an image or an embedding vector, is not recorded at all. The control plane embeds a copy and the runner packages one; make trace-content copies this file and a test on each side refuses a copy that differs.
